statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of five representative paths and all 58 registered checks.

page.framework: server-rendered HTML with deferred JavaScript and Google ad/consent integrations
page.notes: A mobile-first live-score MPA. Public content is mostly server-rendered; consent and advertising inject substantial client UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot and computed-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Under dark preference, body remained rgb(255,255,255), color-scheme was normal, and no dark-theme CSS response was detected.
The preference matched and document.getAnimations() returned no animations, so there was no non-essential motion to suppress.

checkOutcomes.method: prefers-contrast: more computed-style probe plus axe/Lighthouse contrast audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: The contrast preference matched but the page exposed no contrast adaptation; Lighthouse and axe found color-contrast failures.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS/platform probe and representative MPA navigation review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition CSS or API use was found; navigating listing to detail uses abrupt full-document swaps.
The audited templates contain no parallax, scrollytelling, reveal, or other scroll-linked motion to implement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited templates contain no parallax, scrollytelling, reveal, or other scroll-linked motion to implement.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited experience exposes conventional links and tables, with no swipe, pull, carousel, or gesture-driven control.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited experience exposes conventional links and tables, with no swipe, pull, carousel, or gesture-driven control.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The 7,499px results feed has no sticky position-aware navigation, shrinking header, or progress/scrollability cue; CSS contains no scroll-state treatment.
No site-owned tooltip, popover, or anchored menu was present on the representative templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No site-owned tooltip, popover, or anchored menu was present on the representative templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual and DOM review across listing, match, and standings templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Breadcrumb-like green section headers, current filters in bold/red, score links, tabs, Back, and Top links provide explicit orientation and next steps.

checkOutcomes.method: Fresh-load mobile and desktop screenshots, then refusal interaction
checkOutcomes.evidence: A full-viewport consent modal obscures the scores on every fresh profile; after refusal a second “How your data is used” overlay and bottom discovery panel still cover the feed.
Consent surfaces are role=dialog DIVs rather than native dialog/popover primitives; four dialog-like DIVs are present, with large hidden preference/vendor DOM trees.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile/desktop visual review after consent dismissal
checkOutcomes.evidence: The underlying product is a compact, content-dense scores list with little decorative application chrome.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout primitive at 390px and 320px on representative templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home has no overflow at 390px, but match detail at a 320px visual viewport used a 370px layout viewport and reported 50px horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature probe and cross-viewport visual review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The simple single-column score rows resize intrinsically at the principal 390px mobile condition; no reused multi-context component required container-specific behavior.

checkOutcomes.method: Keyboard focus walk and target-rectangle probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Browser focus outlines were visible, but 409 of 412 interactive targets were under 24px in at least one dimension; primary sport/filter links are about 12px high.
The page immediately identifies sport/date/filter state and exposes live scores, score links, standings, and refresh controls.
A score link resolves to a complete match summary with lineups/stats/commentary/H2H links, and standings resolve to a complete data table without an account wall.
The invalid route displays a generic try-later error with a home link, but has no HTTP-specific explanation, retry action, search, or preserved context.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile DevTools trace, layout observer, and Lighthouse corroboration
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile trace measured LCP 4.49s; layout measured CLS 0.092 on home and 0.170 on 320px match detail, outside the good CLS threshold on detail.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout-shift observers on home and match detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Two late shifts produced CLS 0.092 on home and two produced CLS 0.170 on match detail. All 39 inspected images also lacked explicit dimensions.
The 10.3s trace and layout observers recorded zero long tasks and 0ms total blocking time.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page transferred 835KB over 40 requests; 30 requests and 652KB were third-party. Scripts were deferred/async, but the stylesheet and a 49KB Google font were blocking candidates, and ad/consent scripts dominated weight.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR weight review and Lighthouse diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: About 735KB of 835KB transferred was script, dominated by advertising, tag-manager, analytics, and consent code; Lighthouse also reported missing source maps for a large first-party bundle.
axe found a critical unnamed .toggle-btn and an untitled iframe; the page also lacked a main landmark and content regions.
Both independent audits reported insufficient foreground/background contrast.

checkOutcomes.method: axe heading/landmark audit and keyboard focus walk
checkOutcomes.evidence: The content page has no H1 or main landmark and axe found heading-order and region failures. Focus is visible, but structure does not support efficient assistive navigation.
Body text computes to 11px, with dense 12px-high rows and low-contrast grey event metadata, making the long scores feed cramped.

checkOutcomes.method: Narrow reflow layout and target-size probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: At 320px the match template overflows by 50px, and 409 of 412 targets are smaller than 24px in at least one dimension.
Lighthouse did not report an errors-in-console failure during load.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, image primitive, and Lighthouse asset audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but all 39 images lack width/height attributes; 38 blank GIF markers lack alt and Lighthouse reported low-resolution image delivery.
Lighthouse reported missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript; seven advertising/consent iframes also have empty titles.

checkOutcomes.method: Metadata inspection on home, match, and standings
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home and standings have descriptive metadata, but match detail reuses the generic homepage description instead of describing France 4–6 England.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw/rendered discoverability diff and DOM link/viewport inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Core links use real href values, viewport metadata is present, and 94% of rendered content words are in raw server HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: robots.txt, sitemap request, canonical and metadata inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: robots.txt advertises an HTTP sitemap URL that returned 404 and disallows /match/ and /standings/ for general crawlers, limiting indexability of core public detail templates.
No JSON-LD was present for live scores/SportsEvent entities, and og:image points to the site root rather than an image.
HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS, nosniff, framing protection, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are absent. Five cookies are not Secure and use SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: Tracker primitive, HAR, and consent-copy review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load contacted 12 third-party origins including four known trackers; 30 requests and 652KB were third-party, while the consent UI states data may be shared with 210 partners and precise geolocation used.

checkOutcomes.method: Load behavior, DOM and script inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No browser permission prompt or authentication surface appeared on load; passkeys are not applicable to the unauthenticated scores journey.
No HSTS, frame-ancestors/X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy was delivered; long-lived analytics/consent cookies use SameSite=None without Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw HTML vs rendered DOM and crawler screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML returned 200 and contained 94% of rendered content words; the crawler screenshot shows the live score list without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative overlay, listing, match, and table review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Core content is server-rendered and links remain functional; the consent dialog stays inside the mobile viewport and can be refused.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest fetch and service-worker registration probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: A standalone manifest with icons exists, but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned no registrations, so this app-like live-score site has no offline fallback.
A failed route shows only “requested page can’t be displayed, try again later” plus home; it does not distinguish not-found/network states or offer retry/search/context recovery.
html lang=en is correct for visible copy, but the CSS probe found no logical properties and the fixed 370px minimum suggests weak writing-mode/translation resilience.
Match detail renders “18.07.2026 23:00” without locale context or a locale-selectable format, despite covering global events.
Event time is shown as 23:00 without a time-zone label or indication that it is localized, making global event timing ambiguous.

checkOutcomes.method: Consent, advertising, and betting visual review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent and refusal are equally prominent; ads and odds are labeled, and gambling support/18+ text is present. The large vendor footprint is reported separately as privacy/noise, not deceptive wording.
No user-authored form or validation journey exists on the representative scores, match, and standings templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user-authored form or validation journey exists on the representative scores, match, and standings templates.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No address, payment, sign-in, sign-up, or other user-entry fields exist in the representative product flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: No address, payment, sign-in, sign-up, or other user-entry fields exist in the representative product flow.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Betting links are visibly labeled as odds/Bet now, identify the provider, and the page includes Gamble Responsibly, Gambling Therapy, and 18+ notices; no account or subscription flow is hosted here.
All 39 images are PNG/GIF, none use a modern format, all lack dimensions, and 38 below-fold markers are not lazy-loaded. Absolute image bytes are small, but delivery is avoidably dated.
No long task or ongoing main-thread blocking was recorded; the content architecture is mostly server-rendered and lightweight at runtime.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party byte attribution and tracker inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Third parties account for 652KB of 835KB and 30 of 40 requests, mostly ads, consent, tag manager, analytics, and a large external font, disproportionate to the small text scores page.
No declared agent-facing or transactional capability is in scope; the emerging WebMCP opportunity is not treated as a failure for this read-only scores site.
checkOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing or transactional capability is in scope; the emerging WebMCP opportunity is not treated as a failure for this read-only scores site.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model feature is part of the observed core task, so on-device inference is not applicable.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or language-model feature is part of the observed core task, so on-device inference is not applicable.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary before and after 10 consent Learn-more open/close repetitions
checkOutcomes.evidence: Post-interaction heap was only 92KB (0.48%) above baseline with 781 additional nodes and no constructor-sized monotonic growth signal, providing no evidence of an unbounded leak.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary totals judged against page purpose
checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline retained heap was 19.3MB across 326k nodes; script-heavy consent/advertising code is non-trivial but the footprint remained bounded in the repeated interaction sample.
The top-constructor diff showed no Detached* constructor growth and only 0.48% total growth after ten disclosure cycles; no accumulating listener/timer signature was observed in available summaries.

principleOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing or transactional capability is in scope; the emerging WebMCP opportunity is not treated as a failure for this read-only scores site. No summarisation or language-model feature is part of the observed core task, so on-device inference is not applicable.

paths.description: Homepage/live scores listing: primary score-discovery journey and shared global shell.
Hockey listing: representative alternate sport template; de-duplicates other sport listings.
Finished France–England match: representative event detail, tabs, timeline, odds, and narrow reflow.
NPL Northern NSW standings: representative structured table/detail template.

findings.summary: Hard-coded light theme ignores dark preference
findings.evidence: The dark-mode probe kept a white body and normal color-scheme.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and supply preference-driven dark surface/text tokens.

findings.summary: Contrast is insufficient and does not adapt to user preference
findings.evidence: Axe/Lighthouse report contrast failures and prefers-contrast caused no adaptation.
findings.suggestedFix: Meet WCAG contrast ratios and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast-safe styles.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt full-document swaps
findings.evidence: No View Transition styles were found for listing-to-detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long result feeds lack scroll-aware orientation
findings.evidence: A 7,499px feed has no sticky current filter/header or scroll-position affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep compact context/filter chrome visible or add a lightweight scroll-position cue.

findings.summary: Privacy and discovery overlays repeatedly obscure the core scores
findings.evidence: Fresh loads are fully covered by consent; after refusal another notice and discovery panel cover content.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise the consent interruption, suppress secondary promotional overlays after refusal, and preserve immediate access to scores.

findings.summary: Dialog-like UI is built from role=dialog DIVs
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found four custom dialog DIVs and a large hidden vendor tree.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog/popover primitives with declarative dismissal and lazy-mount detailed vendor content.

findings.summary: Match detail overflows narrow mobile viewports
findings.evidence: At a 320px viewport, layout width was 370px with 50px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed minimum widths and use intrinsic/fluid sizing so detail content reflows at 320px and zoom.

findings.summary: Almost every interactive target is too small for touch
findings.evidence: 409 of 412 targets were under 24px in at least one dimension; many links are only 12px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase link hit areas toward 44 CSS px while retaining visible keyboard focus.

findings.summary: Failure states are generic and weakly recoverable
findings.evidence: The invalid route offers only a generic try-later message and home link.
findings.suggestedFix: Distinguish not-found/network errors and offer retry, search, back, and preserved context.

findings.summary: Mobile loading is slow and visually unstable
findings.evidence: Trace LCP was 4.49s; CLS reached 0.092 on home and 0.170 on match detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve all late content space, remove banner-induced shifts, and prioritize the actual LCP path.

findings.summary: Third-party JavaScript dominates a small text page
findings.evidence: 30/40 requests and 652KB/835KB were third-party; script totaled 735KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential ads/analytics until consent or intent, reduce vendors, and trim duplicate tag/consent code.

findings.summary: Controls and frames lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Axe found a critical unnamed toggle and an untitled iframe.
findings.suggestedFix: Name every button and iframe, and remove decorative frames from the accessibility tree.

findings.summary: Document structure lacks an H1 and main landmark
findings.evidence: Axe found no main landmark, no content H1, heading-order errors, and uncontained regions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one descriptive H1, main/nav/footer landmarks, and a sequential heading hierarchy.

findings.summary: Core score text is cramped at 11px
findings.evidence: Computed body text is 11px and result rows are about 12px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise the base type size/line-height and improve spacing while preserving the dense score format.

findings.summary: Image markup and formats are dated
findings.evidence: All 39 images lack dimensions; all are PNG/GIF and 38 decorative blank GIFs lack alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace spacer GIFs with CSS, add intrinsic dimensions, empty alt for decorative images, and modern formats where useful.

findings.summary: Production bundles lack source maps and ad frames lack titles
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flagged missing source maps; platform probe found seven untitled iframes.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish protected production source maps and ensure injected frames are titled or hidden appropriately.

findings.summary: Match pages reuse generic metadata
findings.evidence: The France–England detail has a match title but the generic homepage description.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique match descriptions and share metadata from visible event data.

findings.summary: Core detail pages are blocked and the advertised sitemap is broken
findings.evidence: robots disallows /match/ and /standings/ and its HTTP sitemap URL returns 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a working HTTPS sitemap and align robots/canonicals with intended public detail indexing.

findings.summary: Sports entities lack structured/share metadata
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD exists and og:image points to the site root.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate SportsEvent/Organization JSON-LD and valid Open Graph images for shareable pages.

findings.summary: Transport defenses and cookie flags are missing
findings.evidence: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, referrer and permissions policies are absent; five cookies lack Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, referrer/permissions policies, and Secure appropriate SameSite cookies.

findings.summary: Tracking and partner footprint is excessive
findings.evidence: Twelve third-party origins and four known trackers load; consent names 210 partners and precise geolocation.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise partners and collection, gate trackers on consent, shorten retention, and avoid precise location unless explicitly needed.

findings.summary: Installable presentation has no offline fallback
findings.evidence: A standalone manifest is present but no service worker registration exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Either provide a small service worker/offline shell for saved results or remove the unsupported installable promise.

findings.summary: Global event times are locale and time-zone ambiguous
findings.evidence: Match dates use a fixed 18.07.2026 23:00 form with no zone; CSS lacks logical-property evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Format dates with Intl, label/convert time zones, and migrate layout spacing to logical properties.
